title: From raw text to token embeddings
source_copy: Desktop copy supplied by the instructor

steps.label: Convert text into token IDs, then look up trainable embeddings.
BPE, Unigram, and WordPiece are three subword approaches.
Fit the tokenizer on a corpus to obtain its vocabulary and rules.
Use the fitted tokenizer to segment new text; the embedding table is learned separately with the model.
